manuals.title: Checkweigher: weight rejects
manuals.text: W4-A17 underweight and W4-A18 overweight rejects. Most likely cause: load cell out of calibration, zero drift of the weighing cell. Check the reference weight. Less likely: the filler upstream underfills or overfills bottles; check fill pressure and nozzles.

manuals.title: Checkweigher: weight rejects (revised)
manuals.text: W4-A17 underweight rejects: first check the filler. A blocked or clogged filling nozzle lowers fill pressure and fill weight. W4-A18 overweight: zero drift of the load cell; recalibrate with the reference weight.

manuals.title: Checkweigher: cap inspection
manuals.text: W4-A21 cap inspection rejects: caps loose or skewed. Check capper torque; a worn clutch lets the torque drift low. Adjust torque setpoint and inspect the capping heads.

manuals.title: Checkweigher: label inspection
manuals.text: W4-A22 label rejects: labels skewed or wrinkled. Usually the labeler glue is too cold; check the glue roller temperature and heater. Also check label roll splices.

manuals.title: Checkweigher: infeed starved
manuals.text: W4-A01 infeed starved: no bottles arriving. Check the conveyor from the labeler for a jam or a tripped motor; high motor current means a jam.

manuals.title: Filler: fill pressure
manuals.text: F1-A05 fill pressure low: product supply or a clogged nozzle. Clean the nozzles and check the product valve.

manuals.title: Capper: torque
manuals.text: C2-A08 cap torque out of tolerance: worn clutch, slipping capping chuck. Replace clutch pads.

manuals.title: Labeler: glue and outfeed
manuals.text: L3-A11 glue temperature low: heater cartridge or thermostat failure; check heater current. L3-A02 outfeed blocked: the conveyor after the labeler is jammed or the checkweigher is not taking bottles.

manuals.title: Case packer: outfeed blocked
manuals.text: P5-A03 outfeed blocked: cases are not taken away. Check the palletizing robot: gripper vacuum, suction cups and vacuum hoses. A leaking hose drops the vacuum and the robot faults.

manuals.title: Palletizer: gripper vacuum
manuals.text: R6-A40 gripper vacuum low: leaking suction cup or hose. Replace cups, check the vacuum generator.
